description: This file defines the AdminPathConfigEntityConverter class, which extends EntityConverter to ensure that unmodified ConfigEntity objects are loaded on admin pages within Drupal. It handles conversion of route arguments to config entities, specifically for admin routes, and manages overrides and entity type checks.

classes.name: AdminPathConfigEntityConverter
classes.description: A converter class that loads unmodified config entities on admin pages, overriding default entity conversion when applicable.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the converter with entity type manager, config factory, admin context, and optional entity repository.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts route argument values to config entities, ensuring no overrides are loaded for admin routes.

methods.name: applies
methods.description: Determines if this converter applies to a given route and parameter definition, primarily for config entities on admin routes.
